title: THE MAP HEADER STANDS CLEAR OF THE FRAME
why: Found by the 4K visual pass of 2026-10-09 (W-D3). On the 4K sector map the header line (SECTOR MAP, CLICK to set a waypoint and the weather on the right) stood right on the map frame, touching its top line. The frame has grown with the screen for a long time, but the gap under the header was a fixed 10 pixels, which at 4K the thicker frame used up. The gap now grows with the screen too, so the header sits clear of the frame at 4K as it does at 1080p. At 1080p nothing moves.
now: On a 4K screen the SECTOR MAP header no longer sits on the map frame.
